issue.title: `ComposeRedundantComposable` false positive on composable lambda invocation
Idea: Suggest NonRestartableComposable on simple composables that just call through to one other composable
`ComposeReadOnlyComposable` false negative on read in default argument expression
Rule to detect not passing modifier to all branches
ComposeMutableParameters false positive: types matched by simple name (including extension receivers)
`ComposeParameterOrder` fix could respect existing trailing comma
issue.body:
If an offending function has a trailing comma, the fix should also have a trailing comma. Currently the trailing comma is removed.

You could also say that one should have a trailing comma policy and automatic formatting which handles this! And you'd be right, but some people might not have a policy for this configured and the fix ends up creating tons of otherwise-unchanged lines due to comma removals.

issue.title: Consider check for composable which could be `@ReadOnlyComposable`
issue.body:
A `@Composable` function that only calls `@ReadOnlyComposable @Composable` functions can itself be annotated with `@ReadOnlyComposable`.

The Compose compiler itself enforces the inverse invariant (RO cannot call non-RO).

issue.title: ComposeRedundantComposable incorrectly suggests removing @Composable
issue.body: Hello, `ComposeRedundantComposable` reports correctly in most cases, but I noticed one scenario that is not handled properly. The IDE suggests removing the `@Composable` annotation, even though the function contains a composable call to `BoxWithConstraints`. It seems this case is being incorrectly identified as redundant.
